notes.title: Release notes for update on May 28, 2025
notes.content:
Face enhancement model improvements.
Fix NVIDIA RTX 50XX series GPU hanging issue.

notes.title: New features update on March 12, 2025
notes.content: New video adjustments functions: brightness, contrast, saturation, sharpness, and white balance.

notes.title: New features update on January 15, 2025
notes.content:
New features updates:
[list]
[*] Add a new model: Face enhancement, which is used to enhance the details of the human faces in the video.
[/list]

notes.title: New features update on November 19, 2024
notes.content:
New feature updates:
[list]
[*] Added a new model: Versatile, which is used to reduce artifacts after magnification and provide clear and natural image effects.
[*] Added AI interpolation function to increase the video frame rate and generate additional video frames to smooth the video.
[*] Added AI slow motion function to convert ordinary videos into smooth slow motion videos.
[/list]
